lines.en: Sara and I meet up somewhere between her bar and the[school] and decide to spend the afternoon walking around the city together.
lines.zh: 我和 Sara 约在她酒吧和[school]之间的地方碰头，决定花一个下午一起在城里走走。

lines.en: She doesn't normally act like an adult, but her [teenager]-at-heart attitude rings even more true than usual when she's let out in the snow.
lines.zh: 她平时就不怎么像个大人，可一到雪地里撒欢，她那颗[teenager]般的心比往常还真切。

lines.en: Every time I turn my head, she scoops up whatever she can find and turns it into a snowball before tossing it at my head.
lines.zh: 每次我一转头，她就抓起手边能抓到的东西攥成雪球，朝我脑袋砸过来。

lines.en: I want to be annoyed, but her childish laughter each time it happens disables my anger-receptors and I must now freeze for the sake of her happiness.
lines.zh: 我本想生气，可每次她那孩子气的笑声都会让我愤怒的接收器失灵，于是为了她开心，我只能继续挨冻。

lines.en: Oh well. Worse things have happened, I guess.
lines.zh: 算了。反正更糟的事也不是没发生过。

lines.en: I'm glad she's having a good time.
But she needs to watch her fucking back because I am a snowball-fighting champion.
lines.zh: 不过她最好给我小心点，因为我可是打雪仗的冠军。

lines.en: I return the favor eventually and, instead of getting mad, Sara's eyes light up and she jumps into my arms.
lines.zh: 最后我也还手了；Sara 不但没生气，眼睛反倒一亮，跳进了我怀里。

lines.en: She doesn't try to kiss me or anything like that.
She just looks into my eyes and smiles.
lines.zh: 她只是看着我的眼睛，笑了。

lines.en: And before I know it, the two of us part ways and are back on our own.
lines.zh: 等我反应过来，我俩已经各自道别、分头走了。

lines.en: But not before making plans to do this again soon.
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，我们约好了下次再来。
